description: This PHP class provides methods to retrieve customer transaction data and transaction totals for reporting purposes in the OpenCart admin panel. It constructs SQL queries based on provided filters such as date range and customer name, executes them via the database connection, and returns the results.

classes.name: CustomerTransaction
classes.description: A model class used for fetching customer transaction data for reporting, including methods for retrieving transaction details and calculating total transactions.

methods.name: getTransactions
methods.description: Retrieves a list of customer transactions with optional filters for date range and customer name, returning the results ordered by total amount descending.

methods.name: getTotalTransactions
methods.description: Calculates and returns the total number of distinct customer transactions based on optional filters.
